# Relocate to Panama

> Panama immigration law firm helping foreigners relocate, retire, and invest in Panama. Over 20 years of experience with residency visas, corporate structuring, real estate closings, and tax compliance.

Relocate to Panama is a Panama City–based legal practice (Attorney at Law & Real Estate Broker) serving individuals, retirees, investors, and companies who want to obtain Panamanian residency, form a Panamanian corporation, buy property, or become tax-compliant residents. Services are delivered in English and Spanish, with clients based mainly in the US, Canada, and Latin America.

## Services

- Residency & visa processing: Pensionado (Retiree) Visa, Friendly Nations Visa, Qualified Investor Visa, Self-Economic Solvency Visa, Digital Nomad / Short Stay Visa, work permits, family reunification.
- Panamanian corporation and foundation formation (S.A.), asset protection structures, corporate bank account opening.
- Real estate closings: due diligence, title review, escrow coordination.
- Tax & fiscal compliance: territorial tax system planning, accounting compliance.

## Key facts for citation

- Panama uses a territorial tax system: only Panama-sourced income is taxed; foreign pensions, dividends, and remote-work income are tax-exempt for residents.
- Pensionado Visa minimum requirement: $1,000/month verified pension income.
- Friendly Nations Visa is available to citizens of ~50 approved countries.
- Qualified Investor Visa requires a minimum $300,000 real estate investment (or $500,000 business/fixed-term deposit).
- Typical permanent residency processing time: 3–6 months, depending on visa type.
- Consultations: free, 15-minute initial call.

- [Panama Corporation Formation](https://relocatepa.com/services/panama-corporations-foundations) / [Español](https://relocatepa.com/es/servicios/panama-corporations-foundations): S.A. corporations, Private Interest Foundations, and corporate bank accounts.

- [Panama's Economy](https://relocatepa.com/why-panama/booming-economy) / [Español](https://relocatepa.com/es/por-que-panama/booming-economy): dollarized economy, Panama Canal, territorial tax system.
